units.title: Freeze contracts
units.objective: Freeze the closed public execution-plan schemas so downstream packages compile against a stable contract.
requirements: Add a versioned successor schema whose units carry every applicable value directly, with no ID-indirection into a separate map.
Reject unknown fields on every object in the contract.
approach: Define ExecutionPlanUnitV2 and ExecutionPlanContractV2 alongside the existing v1 types without modifying v1.
Export parse and validate entry points from the package barrel.
tests: A valid fixture parses and normalizes to a stable digest.
An invalid fixture with a missing required field is rejected and names the unit and field.
acceptance: The contracts package exports parseExecutionPlanContractV2 and validateExecutionPlanContractV2.
Every behavior-bearing unit carries objective, requirements, files, approach, tests, acceptance, and verification directly.
verification: Run the contracts package test suite and confirm the new fixtures pass.

units.title: Add corpora
units.objective: Add valid and invalid fixture corpora that exercise the v2 contract's structural validation deterministically.
requirements: Cover duplicate unit IDs, dependency cycles, unresolved dependency references, invalid command names, unknown fields, and a missing required unit field.
approach: Mirror the existing v1 fixture corpus shape with v2-specific field content.
tests: Each invalid fixture rejects with a stable diagnostic path routed through the shared contracts fixture test.
acceptance: Invalid corpora reject with stable diagnostic paths naming the offending field.
verification: Run the contracts package test suite and confirm every fixture in the corpus is exercised.
